tokens.faq_1_question: What should I do immediately if a pipe bursts in my home?
tokens.faq_1_answer: Locate and shut off your main water supply valve immediately to stop the flooding, then call our 24/7 emergency dispatch hotline.
tokens.faq_2_question: Do you charge extra for midnight, weekend, or holiday plumbing calls?
tokens.faq_2_answer: We maintain transparent, flat-rate emergency pricing with no hidden surprise fees, regardless of whether you call at 3 AM or on Christmas Day.
tokens.faq_3_question: How do you clear tough sewer line clogs?
tokens.faq_3_answer: We utilize advanced video camera inspections to locate the exact blockage and employ high-pressure hydro-jetting to clear roots, grease, and debris completely.
tokens.faq_4_question: Can you help with insurance claims for water damage caused by plumbing leaks?
tokens.faq_4_answer: Yes, we provide detailed technical documentation, photo logs, and itemized scopes of work directly to your insurance adjuster.
tokens.faq_5_question: Are your plumbers fully licensed and certified?
tokens.faq_5_answer: Every technician on our team is a state-certified licensed plumber, fully background-checked, insured, and highly experienced.
